_doc: Homepage 'Happening right now' section. Keyed by month number. Each item: q = the trigger question in the visitor's voice, sub = one plain sentence, href = target page (item is SKIPPED if the file doesn't exist yet). 'breaking' may be swapped by the weekly update job when a real change lands; it fills the last slot when present.
